scope: Read-only review of existing private collector artifacts. No production requests, hardware writes, restarts, collector changes or release publication were performed by this review.

collector_status_snapshot.interpretation: Collector health only; an uninterrupted HA subscription does not establish hardware transport health.

readable_event_prefix.interpretation: Supports partial availability stability, including the settling deadline, for the subscribed entity set. The compressed stream was still being written; newer events reported by collector status were not yet readable in this buffered prefix. This is not evidence of an acquisition gap or proof of fresh local measurements.

cached_diagnostics.affected_evidence: Acquisition values in inverter, parallel-group and GridBOSS energy_sample_times remain serialized as <datetime>.
cached_diagnostics.interpretation: These captures cannot establish acquisition freshness or per-field contributing lineage. State publication timestamps are not a substitute.

existing_log_excerpts.method: Deduplicated matching dongle/link connection-warning lines by timestamp across the existing collector log excerpts.
existing_log_excerpts.interpretation: Connection warnings recur after deployment. Excerpts are not a complete failure census and do not establish cause, fallback duration, acquisition freshness, natural recovery or candidate attribution.

historical_midnight_evidence.interpretation: Previously reviewed numeric daily resets precede the deployed-candidate soak. Recorder history lacks contributing acquisition lineage and does not demonstrate the missed-reset guard, cached/member-loss recovery or device counter reset timezone.

693.remaining: Correlate warning timestamps with successful local acquisitions, poll durations, source selection, fallback intervals and any natural recovery. Explicitly retain unresolved cause or unobserved recovery.

694.remaining: Complete the existing 24-hour post-settling window, inspect final capture continuity, reconcile any registry additions, and review natural midnight with qualified provenance. Preserve untested scenarios; elapsed time alone does not satisfy acceptance.

666.remaining: Preserve actual numeric-source contributors and acquisition timestamps across midnight. Nonempty, entirely LOCAL, same-HA-day lineage is required for baseline expiration; cached, missing, HTTP, unknown and mixed-day cases must remain conservative. Cloud, battery and chart counter-day semantics remain unresolved.

limitations: The required natural midnight and full observation window were still in the future at the inspected heartbeat.
The collector subscribes to the existing enabled entity set; later registry additions require separate reconciliation.
Stable published availability does not distinguish fresh local readings from cloud fallback or cached data.
No forced outage, clock change, generator operation, full reconfiguration or rollback exercise is included.
Raw private captures, entity identifiers, network addresses and unredacted log text are intentionally excluded.
